correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of \(H=x^2+y^2+z^2+w^2\) along the printed vector field cancels identically, and the divergence is identically zero. With \(a,b\ne0\), the origin is the only equilibrium, so every nonzero invariant sphere is compact and contains no equilibrium. The flow direction therefore supplies one zero Lyapunov exponent. Conservation gives \(dH_{\phi_t(p)}D\phi_t(p)=dH_p\); because \(\|dH\|=2R\) on the sphere, the one-dimensional normal quotient has a second zero exponent. Liouville's formula gives zero total exponent sum, leaving an opposite pair \(\lambda,-\lambda\). Independent symbolic reconstruction verified both exact cancellations and the source example's energy.
risks: The theorem concerns exact continuous-time asymptotic exponents, not finite-time output of a non-structure-preserving integrator.
